english.note: Use this when you specifically want to stress that paper is no longer used, especially in formal descriptions or compounds such as 無紙化賬單.

examples.english: The company will introduce paperless bills next month, and customers will receive them by email.
examples.traditional: 公司下個月推行無紙化賬單，客戶會用電郵收單。
